// how: Worktrees popup (cmd-shift-n), mods/repo-worktree: list, open, create (in the background), remove (Tab marks, Enter).
Every repo works. A repo with no entry uses strategy "git": git worktree add into ~/.herdr/worktrees/<repo>/<name>.
"defaults": options for every repo (an entry overrides them). Strategies: mods/repo-worktree/strategies/.
Removal is full by default: containers, folder, branch ("remove": { "docker": false, "deleteBranch": false } to keep them).
